en: About diving for breakfast
The night was stormy, with scary lightning and a howling wind. Early in the morning, the Moomin family discovered that the whole valley was flooded.
But a flood is no reason to skip breakfast! Moomintroll and Little My decided to look for something to have their coffee with buns.

The kitchen was filled with water, but that wasn’t a big problem. The real trouble was an angry catfish resting inside. Luckily, our friends are clever, so they lured it away with flashes of light from a mirror!
Moomintroll bravely dived into the kitchen and managed to find a can of dry coffee.
It turned out the buns had been washed out of the kitchen. Moomintroll had a hard time catching them, with a little help from Little My.
It wasn’t very hard to reach the Moomin family china. A beautiful set for drinking coffee!
The dining room had turned into a giant crab’s playground. Moomintroll gave it something new to play with and returned with an elegant coffee pot.
About living in a haunted house

The water was rising, and the Moomin family decided to have breakfast on the roof. All the buns were eaten when Misabel appeared and told them about a haunted house nearby. Moomintroll and Little My were eager to explore it.

When the whole family got inside the strange house, it started to float away from Moominvalley! Moominpappa had an idea to turn the place into a ship and sail back home. The family agreed, and they started to search for all the necessary things.
Misabel was right! The house was haunted, and Moomintroll and Little My had to catch a ghost! Luckily, they had Snorkmaiden’s knowledge of spiritualism and proper dressing.
The ghost, looking very much like an old rat, fled but dropped a captain’s hat, a perfect one for Moominpappa.
One of the most necessary things for sea adventures, a barometer, was kept by a lonely Hattifattener. The creature was happy to listen to a disastrous forecast and left the theatre immediately.
The weather inside the strange house changed, but there was no sun. And how should a sailor find the way without it? So Little My had to find the sun first!
About revenge and the dangers of Midsummer Night
Little My fell from the stage and was carried far away by the current. What a funny trip it was! Now the only thing she had to do was return to her sister and tell Mymble about her adventures.

Who could have imagined she would meet Snufkin, Moomintroll’s best friend, in the park! Snufkin was heading to Moominvalley, as he did every summer, but he still had one piece of unfinished business with the Park Keeper. Little My agreed to help him.
The politest Woodie dreamed of having a cute pet. A big green frog was just what they needed!
The smallest Woodie had an artistic soul, so Little My gave them bright paints to support young talent.
The quietest Woodie just wanted to be a bush. Little My knew only one bush — an angry Angostura. So she turned the kid into it!
About revenge and the dangers of Midsummer Night
Moomintroll and Snorkmaiden, all soaked and cold, finally reached the shore. But where were they? And how could they get back to the family?
The friends met Fillyjonk. Poor thing — she was ill and desperately lonely on Midsummer’s Eve. Moomintroll promised to find cough syrup for her, while Snorkmaiden took care of her.

After taking the medicine, Fillyjonk felt much better! She was ready to lend her boat to help them get home, but she was still so sad and lonely. So the friends decided to celebrate Midsummer together with her.
Snorkmaiden and Fillyjonk made a big festive bonfire from some old signs, and Moomintroll went to pick a magic Midsummer bouquet.
About revenge and the dangers of Midsummer Night

What a piece of mischief it was! Snufkin, Little My, and the Woodies turned the park upside down! Now the whole company was resting in an empty house. But not Little My — she was about to reach the theatre. Snufkin would help her, as soon as he made sure Moomintroll was there too.
A spoiled piece of a poster was found in a puddle, all wet and torn. Little My carefully put it back together.
Another torn piece of the poster turned out to be on the roof. You could read a crazy story about riding a crow there, but really, it was better to see it!
Glue is always handy when it comes to posters. Little My had to beat someone sitting among boxes and parcels to get it.
About sensitive feet and souls

How happy everyone was to get back together again! Especially after escaping the hands of the Police Hemulen. The flood was going down, so everything was ready to head back to Moominvalley. There were two problems: the theatre stuck in the middle of the creek, and Moominpappa disappeared.
Moominpappa was found in quite a disgraceful position, all tangled up in ropes. Little My and Moomintroll set him free.

It turned out the theatre wasn’t stuck by itself. It was Edward the Booble who was sitting on it. Edward refused to move without some shoes for his delicate feet. Little My and Moomintroll headed off to search for giant slippers.
Love is a complicated thing. After delivering some romantic messages to Misabel, Little My and Moomintroll got an old deflated rubber boat. What use was that?
It was a brilliant idea to tickle Edward the Booble’s foot. He didn’t move much, but it was enough to get an old torn rubber boat. Still better than nothing!
To patch the torn boat, Little My and Moomintroll went to a true knitting master. No, it wasn’t even Moominmamma. It was an old spider.
The boat was inflated, but Little My accidentally broke the pump. That was a pity, because she might have used it one more time.
Teasing a giant is not a good idea, if you’re not Little My. Edward’s habit of blowing opponents away turned out to be very useful for inflating the second boat.
About punishment and reward

It is so wonderful to come back home after an adventure, and so awful to be caught by the police there! Snufkin took the blame for ruining the park and was threatened with going to jail. Snorkmaiden came up with a plan to trick the Police Hemulen. Of course, the plan involved a costume.
You never know what people are really into! The proud mother bird turned out to be a professional pickpocket. She stole the Police Hemulen’s cap while he was watching a very special concert.
Moomintroll and Little My found an old coat. After a few tweaks with golden coins, it looked very impressive. Just perfect for a Police Chief!

Be careful: moray eels are very similar to scarves. To tell them apart, try feeding a scarf with some fishy sauce. If it starts eating, it’s a moray eel. Anyway, now Moomintroll had a scarf, and the moray was well fed.
About a bark boat and a volcano

One hot summer day, Moominmamma and Mymble were sitting on the veranda. Moominmamma was making a beautiful bark boat for her beloved son, Moomintroll. Suddenly, Little My appeared, loud and outrageous! Her sister Mymble tried to catch her, but it’s not so easy to catch the smallest one in the family!
Little My tricked her sister and slipped away into the garden. Now she needs a good place to hide and maybe some help with it!
Little My found a perfect hideout, but Mymble wasn’t chasing her anymore. So Little My and Moomintroll were happy to join Snorkmaiden’s game. Now they need some costumes to play!
Moomintroll and Little My made an outstanding costume for Snorkmaiden, but what a pity! They broke Moominmamma’s boat by accident. But don’t worry, they’ll fix it at once, right?

*cough cough*

Finally!

GRANDPA!
HUSH!

Let's better have a look at it.

Well, well, look at this young generation...
<bold>Binoculars</>! Look there!

<bold>Buns </>? Yuck!

Cups, pots... What a day.... *cough*
Easy!
I have eight eyes, but that doesn't mean a couple are spares!
So, what is he like?! Is he TERRIBLY scary?!
Who?
A sea monster! Is it swimming there?

And now the seagulls are struggling to feast on them.
Oh, I share the same wish!
Well done! We're having a basket full of <bold>buns </>for breakfast!

What a curse to remember!
I think they'll still be delicious.
GROKELY delicious!
Language, Little My!
Everything is sea now!
You should change your address.
Moominwetland, something like that!
And so do I!
Little My, we obviously have to launch you right into the <bold>whirlpool</>!
Haha! That would be quite a story!
You'll bite into a <bold>bun</> and bring it back to us in your mouth.
I won't let go of anything I've bitten!
BUT!
There's a current, and I don’t want it to take away my sister.
Moomin, bring me <bold>something </>to pull her out of the water.
Why do you always need to make things boring?
Because I'm the big sister.
That's what we do.
Little My! Come here, little menace!
... a-a-and done!
Wow, that's handy!
Wish you were always on a leash!
Fat chance!
Hey, where do you think you're going?
It's bun'n'fun time!
Get the <bold>slingshot </>out!

Little My made up everything about this barrel.
But it's better to stay away!

We should invite them for breakfast when it's ready...
The sea has calmed down, but I know the storms it is capable of!

Our beautiful garden got flooded with water...
There's a <bold>whirlpool</>, no more, no less!
This armchair is not ours.
Certainly, it must have floated away from the house of some Hemulen.
Very much in the Hemulen style!
Oh, someone is definitely sitting in this barrel!
How do you know?
In a barrel like this?
I'm sure someone has imprisoned their sworn enemy in there!
Or maybe some pickled cabbage!

It doesn't look like it's made itself at home at all...
It seems someone is in trouble!
Oh, they're just enjoying the morning.
Are they not affected by the flooding?
Just as we are!
The sky is so clear.
As if yesterday's storm never happened.
It's just like my big sister!
She always makes a lot of noise and then forgets about it.
Little My, I swear, I'll send you back to our mother by mail.
Oh! A big one!
Pappa's <bold>binoculars </>used to be there...
I believe Mamma stashed them away during a big spring cleaning.

One can hardly find anything after them!
Now you can't call this summer dry!

Created by a sea monster?
Very likely!
Mymble, we...
Shhh!
I'm enjoying my life. Talk to me later, please.
Hi, Mymble!
What are you doing?
I'm terribly busy doing nothing at all!
Aren't you supposed to look after me, as our mother Mymble told you?

Hah, good luck, Moomintroll!
I think, this will be helpful.
Great! Take the <bold>slingshot</>.
Hey, big sister!
Lazing around?
Actually, I've found something worthwhile to do.
See that flock of seagulls over there?
They're circling something in the water.

What's got them so interested?
I hope it's a sea monster!
Little My, you're quite the ill-mannered one!
But that’d actually be a thrill, indeed!

And maybe we don't need...

Pappa's cane.
